about: Shared scenario vectors for the 'New books on deck' split. Canonical semantics live in dashboard-rows-spec.md. Both repos (komga-reader app derivation + komga/ShabbyFork DAO) must assert these. Bump 'version' on ANY change; each suite asserts the version it was written against, so a one-sided edit fails the other repo's build.
decisionDefinition: latest = max(readDate for completed books); oldest = min(createdDate for NOT-completed books); newDrop = latest != null && oldest != null && oldest > latest  (strict, conservative on null). 'Not completed' = unread OR in-progress.

fields.books[].completed: true = finished (counts toward 'latest'); false/absent = not completed (counts toward 'oldest')
fields.books[].readDate: completion time; only meaningful when completed = true
fields.onDeckCandidate: whether Komga would place this series on deck at all; the app/fork split only ever sees candidates
fields.expectedNewDrop: canonical answer (not-completed definition). Both implementations must return this for onDeckCandidate=true vectors
fields.equivalenceSensitive: true where the app's current UNREAD-only approximation would differ from the canonical not-completed answer (see spec §Row 1 known approximation)

vectors.name: drop_waiting_with_newer_issue
vectors.description: #4 still unread when #5 arrives. Oldest pending (#4) still postdates last read, so #4 stays in new-on-deck.

vectors.name: read_into_drop_next_is_backlog
vectors.description: Read #4 AFTER #5 had already arrived. #5 predates that read, so it is ordinary backlog -> regular On Deck.

vectors.name: caught_up_again_next_new
vectors.description: Read #1-5, then #6 dropped. #6 is new-on-deck again.

vectors.name: mid_series_backlog
vectors.description: An unread issue that was added BEFORE your last read (you left it behind) -> ordinary mid-series On Deck, never new-on-deck.

vectors.name: strict_tie_not_after
vectors.description: Oldest pending createdDate equals latest completion readDate exactly. Comparison is strict, so NOT a new drop.

vectors.name: in_progress_book_off_candidate_path
vectors.description: Series has an in-progress book (added before the last completion) plus a newer unread. Canonical (not-completed) => false. App's UNREAD-only approx => true. Harmless because a series with an in-progress book is NOT an On Deck candidate (it is Keep reading), so this never reaches the split. Documents the approximation; hardening the app to use not-completed removes the gap.

vectors.name: no_completion_unknown_latest
vectors.description: Nothing completed yet (no 'latest'). Conservative: not a new drop.

vectors.name: fully_caught_up_no_pending
vectors.description: Everything completed (no 'oldest'). Series is on no deck row; newDrop is false.
